text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
අති විෙශෂ
No. 1968/7 – TUESDAY, MAY, 24, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY

The Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) Notice Under Section 7 My No.: GANA/4/5/Acquisition/83. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4/3/15/2012/VE/286. I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the land acquisition (amendment) Act, No.28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/Servitude which for a public purpose. Description of the land or Servitude to be acquired:- Six allotments of land described below and depicted in the Plan No. FVP 528, sheet No. 97, supplementary 94 drawn by the Surveyor General and situated in the Grama Niladari Division No. 219D Aluthwatte in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Gangaboda Paththuwa North - Nagoda in Galle District.
1. Lot No. 1614

Name of the Land: Nakiyadeniya Estate; Description: Garden, 10 farm oil trees of age 20-25 yrs, Seed mango tree 3 permanent buildings, parts of three permanent building, and a permanent two storied building; Claimant’s Name and Address: Crown Land; Extent: 0.1212 Hectare.
2. Lot No. 1615
Name of the Land: —; Description: Garden and parts of 4 Permanent, Building; Claimant’s Name and Address: Crown Land; Extent: 0.0085 Hectare. 3. Lot No. 1616

Name of the Land: Nakiyadeniya Estate; Description: Garden, Farm oil trees of age 20-25 years parts of three permanent buildings and a temporary building; Claimant’s Name and Address: Crown Land; Extent: 0.1044 Hectare. 4. Lot No. 1617
Name of the Land: —; Description: Streem; Claimant’s Name and Address: Crown Land; Extent: 0.0513 Hectare. 5. Lot No. 1618

Name of the Land: Nakiyadeniya Estate; Description: Garden, a jack tree of 20-25 years of age jack fruit tree (local), 11 oil farm trees and a well; Claimant’s Name and Address: Crown Land; Extent: 0.1274 Hectare. 6. Lot No. 1619
Name of the Land: Nakiyadeniya Estate; Description: Garden, 20-25 years of age Godapara tree, 2 Kekuna Trees and 11 oil farm trees; Claimant’s Name and Address: Crown Land; Extent: 0.1235 Hectare.

2 A III ෙකොටස - ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් අති විෙශෂ ගැසට් පතය - 2016.05.24 PART III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 24.05.2016

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude are hereby requested to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Nagoda Divisional Secretariat on the 29th day of June 2016 at 10.30 a.m. and are requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 01st day of June 2016 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
SHANIKA THRIMANNA, Divisional Secretary, Nagoda Division. Divisional Secretariat, Nagoda. 04th April, 2016. 06 - 219
